title: Add GitHub Actions CI workflow
description: Create a GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs on push and pull requests to main. Runs Node.js 22, installs dependencies, builds, lints, and tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow triggers on push and PR to main

steps.details: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with: name: CI. on: push: branches: [main], pull_request: branches: [main]. jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest. steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4, - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: '22', - run: npm ci, - run: npm run build, - run: npm run lint, - run: npm test
Use `python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml'))"` to validate the YAML syntax. Or use actionlint if available.

technicalNotes: Use npm ci (not npm install) in CI — it respects package-lock.json exactly and is faster
